PAPRelay transfers, stores, converts and displays data your machine has already recorded. It does not interpret the data, raise alerts, give advice or control the machine.
The device check reads from the machine and changes nothing on it. It writes one test value to Health Connect and removes it again.

PAPRelay is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition, and must not be used to make diagnosis or treatment decisions. Values may be wrong, late or missing. It does not replace myAir, your equipment provider\'s reporting, or advice from a clinician.

PAPRelay is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by ResMed or Google. ResMed, AirSense and myAir are trademarks of ResMed. Android and Health Connect are trademarks of Google LLC.
What PAPRelay does with your data
PAPRelay reads therapy records from your machine over Bluetooth and stores them on this phone. It writes respiratory rate to Health Connect, and other types only if you turn them on.
Your data goes nowhere else. PAPRelay has no internet permission, no accounts, no analytics and no advertising. Data leaves the app only through Health Connect and through files you choose to save.
What PAPRelay reads from Health Connect
PAPRelay reads nothing from other apps. It asks only for permission to write, and reads back only its own records to keep them correct.
Uninstalling PAPRelay deletes everything it stored. Records it wrote to Health Connect can be removed in Health Connect, under App permissions, PAPRelay.
